Method of Attack: Targets routers and NAS devices to steal files, information, and examine network traffic

Consists of three stages: Stage 1 persists after reboot, Stage 2 executes commands and steals data with self-destruct ability, Stage 3 installs plugins for network sniffing, SCADA monitoring, and TOR communication
Stage 2 and 3 are disabled by rebooting the router, but Stage 1 remains
Only full removal is by resetting router to factory defaults
Impacted Systems: Other QNAP NAS devices running QTS software
Attack Vector: Infection of routers and NAS devices
Remote administration exploitation (implied by recommendation to disable remote administration)
